## Notes

Pops share profession, culture, religion, state, and workplace; professions grouped into classes and strata; standard of living sets needs and radicalism; monthly qualifications from literacy and wealth; literacy moves toward education access; migration toward states with higher attraction, mainly standard of living; workforce 25% by default.
